newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico first-half CPI rises 0.70 pct - central bank.
newsitem.headline: Mexico first-half CPI rises 0.70 pct - central bank.

text.p: Mexico's consumer price index rose 0.70 percent in the first half of October compared to the second half of September after rising 1.04 percent in first half of September, Banco de Mexico said Thursday.
A survey of nine Mexican brokerages, banks and research firms forecast inflation of 0.74 percent in the first half of the October.
It said the overall index increase was due mainly to rises in prices of domestic electricity, long-distance telephone tariffs, gasoline, domestic gas, various foods products and other goods.
It said that the basic basket of consumer goods rose 1.04 percent compared to the last two weeks of September.
